Card Q&A.a: Normally, you can place cards from your hand or battle area under a card to be played for a DigiXros, but when this card's [All Turns] effect is activated, you can also place cards from under your Tamers for that card's DigiXros.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's [All Turns] effect do, exactly?
Does this card's [All Turns] effect also allow me to place cards from under a Tamer other than this Tamer for a DigiXros?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it triggers. Cards from under your Tamers can also be placed for each of those cards' DigiXros.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [All Turns] effect also trigger when multiples of the specified cards would be played?

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[All Turns] When any of your [Xros Heart] trait Digimon cards with DigiXros requirements would be played, by suspending this Tamer, cards from under your Tamers can also be placed for their DigiXros.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
